title: DerivedEntity
description: A normalized referent that participates in one or more derived propositions. It may represent a concept, actor, institution, event, state, condition, capability, duty, permission, prohibition, legal power, consequence, outcome, or any domain-specific referent. Identity rule: labels and aliases do NOT define identity — implementations MUST use the opaque `id`. Two candidates MAY be merged only when they denote the same referent under compatible type and scope; uncertain candidates MUST remain separate (or be linked by a non-equivalence relation such as `possiblySameAs`). A DerivedEntity is NOT an authoritative source object and does not replace a source system's canonical identifiers.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this entity. Identity is bound to this value, never to labels.

canonicalLabel.description: A human-readable canonical label. For display and search only; it does NOT define identity.

entityType.description: A profile-defined type for the referent (e.g. 'concept', 'actor', 'duty', 'event'). The core does not enumerate types.

reviewStatus.description: Curation lifecycle status of this entity.

aliases.description: Alternative labels. Like canonicalLabel, aliases never define identity.

description.description: Optional prose description of the referent.

externalIdentifiers.description: Cross-references to identifiers controlled by external systems. These do not confer TIER-Graph identity.

metadata.description: Flexible profile-specific properties. SHOULD use recognized vocabularies for interoperability.

createdAt.description: When this entity record was created (record time, not domain time).

updatedAt.description: When this entity record was last updated (record time, not domain time).
